title: Clipboard doesn't paste copied item that then was moved to somewhere else until the Context Menu is opened
line: Pressing Ctrl+V on the desktop now pastes right away, without having to open a context menu first.
explanation: FolderModel::paste() returns early when its cached Paste action is disabled, but that action's state was only recomputed in updateActions(), which runs on selection changes and when a context menu opens. Copying with Ctrl+C doesn't change the selection, so Ctrl+V still saw the old (empty) clipboard state and silently did nothing until a menu had been opened. paste() now calls updateActions() first, so it checks what is on the clipboard right now.

commits.message:
Folder View: Check the current clipboard when pasting with Ctrl+V

Ctrl+V on the desktop did nothing after copying a file until a context
menu had been opened, because the Paste action was only refreshed then
or on selection changes. Pasting now refreshes the actions first.

BUG: 503828

From 6d21512f274ac15962b60c7e57d3f3d560d3481b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:19:41 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] Folder View: Check the current clipboard when pasting with
 Ctrl+V

Ctrl+V on the desktop did nothing after copying a file until a context
menu had been opened, because the Paste action was only refreshed then
or on selection changes. Pasting now refreshes the actions first.

BUG: 503828
---
 containments/desktop/plugins/folder/foldermodel.cpp | 2 ++
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+)

diff --git a/containments/desktop/plugins/folder/foldermodel.cpp b/containments/desktop/plugins/folder/foldermodel.cpp
index 678bae687c..0712337002 100644
--- a/containments/desktop/plugins/folder/foldermodel.cpp
+++ b/containments/desktop/plugins/folder/foldermodel.cpp
@@ -2263,6 +2263,8 @@ void FolderModel::cut()
 
 void FolderModel::paste()
 {
+    updateActions();
+
     if (QAction *action = m_actionCollection.action(QStringLiteral("paste"))) {
         if (!action->isEnabled()) {
             return;

media.caption: Master: select the file, Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V does nothing; after opening and closing the context menu, Ctrl+V pastes.
Fixed: the first Ctrl+V after Ctrl+C pastes at once.
Master: right after Ctrl+C then Ctrl+V, nothing happens.
Fixed: the same Ctrl+V starts the paste (same folder, so the rename dialog).
